digest.component_or_area: Backend port and adapter layer (Jira family)
propositions: RemoteRef is never constructed in production code; only the frozen dataclass exists with an undocumented instance field that remains unpopulated
The Backend protocol lacks a declared remote_ref() method, causing the contract test to pass against FakeBackend which implements it while real backends do not

RemoteRef.instance was intended to prevent collisions between same-vendor deployments but cannot fix the actual collision point: _jira_key_to_local_id derives ids from Jira keys alone, ignoring instance

The instance value must be derived from the configured base URL and injected at backend construction time rather than resolved at call time, to avoid breaking contract tests that construct backends without ambient config
Both ADRs 0055 and 0035 must be amended to correct the false claim that instance prevents local-id collision and to clarify that vendor alone already separates Cloud from DataCenter
